name: Mesu Ochi! Miwaku no Hitozuma Life ~Toshiuezuma-tachi to no Icha Love Shirudaku Seikatsu~
original_name: メス堕ち！魅惑の人妻ライフ ～年上妻たちとのいちゃらぶ汁だく性活～
source:
The protagonist is currently staying with older brother's family in order to commute to prep school. But his brother suddenly decides to accept a new job position that forces him to move away, leaving his wife and the protagonist alone at home.

Moreover, surrounding the protagonist are his other sister-in-law, his aunt and a neighbor wife. Thus, his life full of attractive older women begins.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc049/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主角目前住在哥哥的家里，以便通勤去预科学校。但他的哥哥突然决定接受新的工作岗位，迫使他搬走，留下妻子和主角独自在家。

而且，围绕着主角的还有他的另一个嫂子、他的姨妈和邻居的妻子。于是，他的生活就开始了充满魅力的老年女性。

[翻译自[url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc049/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
